findings: The heuristic that #321-11 replaced ('an immediate operand after the frame index is its displacement') is upstream MOS code. Besides CmpBrAbsImm16 it also misfires for the HuC6280 HuCMemcpy pseudo, whose destination frame index is followed by the length immediate: upstream adds the block length to the destination instead of the operand's own offset. The 2026-06-19 fix covered this silently, and its plan's claim that CmpBrAbsImm16 is the only affected instruction is wrong. No record or report covers the HuC6280 miscompile.
